lines.tactics.scene.grim_sends: So the Crown sends {c=#8ad0ff}four{/c}. Thornwatch has stood a hundred years, little lord.
lines.tactics.scene.aldo_gate: Then a hundred years is long enough. Open the gate, Grimwald.
lines.tactics.scene.liora_river: Mind the archer on the wall. {w=.3}And keep out of the river: the shallows {c=#8ad0ff}slow{/c} you.
lines.tactics.scene.wren_hill: From up there their bows reach further. {w=.2}So will mine, from the hill.
lines.tactics.keys.command: UP DOWN CHOOSE  {ok} OK  {back} BACK  {turn_l} {turn_r} TURN

notes.tactics.unit.aldo: The heroes' leader, a young paladin of the Crown (he). Unit names are in capitals.
notes.tactics.unit.grimwald: The knight who leads the Ash Legion and holds the fort (he).
notes.tactics.class.paladin: A unit's class, in capitals, on its card. The Legion's archer, mage, priest and thief go by their class as their name too.
notes.tactics.act.bash: A shield blow that knocks a foe back a cell.
notes.tactics.act.cleave: A sweep that cuts the three cells ahead.
notes.tactics.act.volley: Arrows raining on a cross of cells.
notes.tactics.scene.grim_sends: Grimwald mocks Aldo ("little lord"): the Crown sent only four. Thornwatch is the hill fort.
notes.tactics.scene.grim_walls: Grimwald shouts to his soldiers, the Legion.
notes.tactics.scene.aldo_how: Aldo asks the player to choose the battle's turn order; the two answers follow.
notes.tactics.scene.by_speed: A choice: each unit acts in turn, the fastest first (charge time).
notes.tactics.scene.by_phases: A choice: all the heroes act, then all the foes (phases, as in Fire Emblem).
notes.tactics.cmd.end: Ends the player's phase: the heroes still waiting give up their turns.
notes.tactics.cmd.wait: Ends a unit's turn (it then picks the way it faces).
notes.tactics.mp: Magic points: a skill's cost, or what a unit has.
notes.tactics.hit.back: Floats over a unit struck from behind (harder).
notes.tactics.hit.side: Floats over a unit struck from the side.
notes.tactics.slam: A unit knocked back into something: {damage} is the damage it takes.
notes.tactics.turn_of: A banner: {name} is the unit whose turn it is.
notes.tactics.battle.phases: The battle begins, turns by phases.
notes.tactics.skips: Shown beside a key during the scene: that key skips it.
notes.tactics.order: The list of who acts next.
notes.tactics.tag.turn: On a unit's card: the unit whose turn it is.
notes.tactics.panel.class: On a unit's card: its class, then a tag (TURN, ENEMY, ALLY, FOE).
notes.tactics.panel.stats: How far a unit moves, how high it climbs, its speed (SPD). Tiny font: keep it short.
notes.tactics.forecast.heal: While aiming: {name} would be healed by {amount}.
notes.tactics.forecast.hit: While aiming: {name} would lose {amount} HP (SIDE, BACK: struck from there, harder).
notes.tactics.keys.command: Key help, tiny font: UP DOWN and ARROWS are the arrow keys; {ok}, {back}, {turn_l} and {turn_r} are key names (Z, X, Q, E) that confirm, go back and turn the view.
notes.tactics.turn_view: A touch button: turn the view a quarter.
notes.tactics.over.mvp: The unit that dealt the most damage, and how much.
notes.action.turn_l: On the controls screen: the key that turns the view a quarter left ("l": left).
notes.action.turn_r: On the controls screen: the key that turns the view a quarter right ("r": right).
notes.action.skip: On the controls screen: the key that skips the scene before the battle.

brief: The tactics slice: a battle on an isometric map in the manner of Final Fantasy Tactics and Fire Emblem. Four heroes of the Crown (Aldo, he, a paladin who leads; Wren, she, a ranger; Sable, she, a mage; Liora, she, a cleric) storm Thornwatch, a hill fort held by the Ash Legion under the knight Grimwald (he). A short scene before the battle is heroic and a little mocking; the HUD, units and commands are terse, in capitals, as in a 16-bit strategy game. The player commands the heroes and is never addressed by name.
